name: Carrion Defense Works Whisper Veil Counter-Surveillance Cloak
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Whisper Veil Counter-Surveillance Cloak
description: A hooded cloak woven with active signal-jamming fibers that create a localized dead zone around the wearer, blocking all wireless signals within a 2-meter radius. The Whisper Veil disrupts WiFi, cellular, Diaspora connections, Bluetooth, RFID, and neural interface external communications, making the wearer invisible to wireless tracking while simultaneously preventing any electronic eavesdropping. The fabric contains embedded micro-batteries that power the jamming mesh for 6 hours before requiring recharge. The cloak's visual appearance is nondescript — a plain, dark hooded garment that draws no attention in urban environments.

specifications.effect: Complete wireless signal suppression in radius
specifications.side effect: Wearer also loses all wireless connectivity

story_hooks: A murder was committed within a Whisper Veil's jamming radius — no electronic evidence exists for the 2-meter zone around the killing, creating a perfect blind spot in total surveillance coverage.
Modified Whisper Veils with expanded 10-meter jamming radius have appeared on the market — one person wearing it can black out an entire room's communications.
related_entities: Axiom Systems Perception Filter Rounds PFR-1 'Blind Spot'

physical_description.visual_profile: A nondescript hooded cloak resembling a oversized streetwear hoodie or monk's garment. The silhouette is deliberately unremarkable—designed to blend into urban crowds without drawing attention. The hood is deep and shadowing, concealing the wearer's face when drawn.
physical_description.dimensions: Approximately 120-140 cm in length; hood opening roughly 35-40 cm wide. Sized to drape loosely over average adult frame while maintaining mobility.
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld/wearable at 1.2 kg; light enough for extended wear but noticeably substantial compared to standard clothing due to embedded electronics
physical_description.primary_material: Dense synthetic-polymer weave base fabric interlaced with conductive jamming fibers (appears as fine metallic threading running throughout)
physical_description.finish: Matte, non-reflective coating to minimize visual detection. Surface feels slightly stiff and technical rather than soft fabric—almost like reinforced textile. Micro-texture visible under close inspection from woven mesh pattern.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal gray or matte black as primary; inner hood lining occasionally features faint iridescent shimmer (indicating signal-disrupting fiber matrix beneath). Accent stitching in dark gray or charcoal.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimalist design: subtle power indicator (small LED embedded in right shoulder seam, cycles amber when active), recessed charging port hidden within left cuff seam (micro-USB or proprietary connector), palm-sized battery status display patch woven into inner collar (backlit text showing remaining hours). No external buttons—activation likely via pressure-sensitive fabric or near-field gesture.
distinctive_features: Visible metallic fiber threading creates subtle geometric lattice pattern across fabric surface
Faint electrical hum when activated (imperceptible to most but detectable in quiet environments)
Slight static charge aura around hood perimeter when active (can cause minor hair lift)
Internal lining features orientation grid markers to help wearer center themselves in the 2-meter suppression radius
Reinforced collar area with subtle cable routing visible as raised ridges
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo (angular corvid silhouette) embossed on inner neck label. Serial number and jurisdiction compliance stamps on interior right seam. Discreet TIER 2+ regulatory mark woven into hem. No external branding—designed for operational discretion.
physical_description.condition_typical: In active use, the cloak appears perfectly normal from distance; up close, the faint shimmer and fiber lattice suggest technical sophistication. When powered down, indistinguishable from any dark street garment. Light creasing and wear patterns develop naturally along fold lines. Battery indicator subtly glows in darkness when powered.
